g.text: A slow or down subscriber retries on its own growing schedule -- it never slows down, blocks, or waits on any other subscriber.
fans out to every currently active subscription
Meanwhile, Subscriber B's own retry schedule:
-- each gap is wider than the last: exponential backoff, spread further apart by jitter --
Subscriber B's retries never touch A's or C's worker capacity -- A and C were done in milliseconds while B was still failing its third attempt.
